flags.reason: The guide's info buttons are IconButtons with Emphasis Low and Button / Size S (src/guides/tooltip.guide.tsx, INFO), but no guide sentence says so. Under the building rules the entry's examples leave modes at their defaults, so an agent builds the info button as a default IconButton (Emphasis High, size M), not the quiet small i the guide shows. Guide fix #517: say what the info button should look like. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-batch4, for Marcin to confirm.

summary: Use a Tooltip to explain a term or icon in a short line that opens from an info button and closes with the next press.

useWhen.text: Explain a term or icon in a short line that opens from an info button and closes with the next press.

from.quote: Use a Tooltip to explain a term or icon in a short line that opens from an info button and closes with the next press.
One short explanation, on request.

useWhen.text: Explaining terms in a list of details, such as a fund's NAV, expense ratio and exit load, each with its own info button.

from.quote: A fund's details list three terms, each with an info button.

avoidWhen.text: Writing a paragraph: four sentences fill the bubble and cover the screen behind it.

from.quote: Four sentences fill the bubble and cover the screen behind it.

avoidWhen.text: Putting it on the main action: every press on that action (such as Invest now) also pops a bubble over the screen.

anatomy.holds: Yours: an info IconButton passed to TooltipTrigger with asChild. Pressing it opens or closes the bubble. It is the only part that sits in the page.

from.quote: Yours: an info IconButton passed with asChild. Pressing it opens or closes the bubble.

anatomy.holds: The word it explains, beside the trigger on the screen. Keep it visible: the bubble only adds detail.

from.quote: The word it explains. Keep it visible: the bubble only adds detail.

anatomy.holds: The TooltipContent, drawn over the page 12 px from the trigger: 8 px corners, 12 × 8 px of padding, white 14 px text that wraps at 280 px, and a 16 × 8 px arrow pointing at the trigger.

configuration.text: placement picks the side, top by default, and can line the bubble up with the trigger's start or end edge instead of its centre.

from.quote: Placement picks the side, top by default, and can line the bubble up with the trigger's start or end edge instead of its centre.

configuration.text: Above (top) is the default: the bubble sits above, its arrow pointing down at the trigger.

from.quote: The default: the bubble sits above, its arrow pointing down at the trigger.

configuration.text: Below (bottom) is for triggers near the top of the screen, where there's no room above.

from.quote: For triggers near the top of the screen, where there's no room above.

configuration.text: Start-aligned (top-start): the bubble's start edge lines up with the trigger's; the arrow still points at it.

from.quote: The bubble's start edge lines up with the trigger's; the arrow still points at it.

configuration.text: Beside the trigger (right) is for a row with room to its side. On a phone there rarely is, so it opens above or below instead.

from.quote: Next to the trigger, for a row with room to its side. On a phone there rarely is, so it opens above or below instead.

configuration.text: When the bubble doesn't fit on its side it flips to the opposite one; beside the trigger with no room either way, it moves above or below.

from.quote: When the bubble doesn't fit on that side it flips to the opposite one, and beside the trigger with no room either way it moves above or below.

configuration.text: Pass the info IconButton to TooltipTrigger with asChild, so the button itself is the trigger.

from.quote: though a Coin button nested inside the trigger opens it too.

configuration.text: The bubble is as wide as its text up to 280 px, then wraps. A width on TooltipContent sets it instead, like Figma's Custom Width variant.

configuration.text: The screen can open it itself with open, for example for a first-time hint, and hears every close through onOpenChange.

from.quote: The screen can also open it itself with open and hear every close through onOpenChange.

examples.purpose: Explain a term: one sentence that says what NAV means, opened from the i next to it. The term stays on the page as Text; the info IconButton, passed with asChild, is the trigger.
examples.jsx:
<HStack alignVertical="center">
  <Text>NAV</Text>
  <Tooltip>
    <TooltipTrigger asChild>
      <IconButton iconName="ic_info" accessibilityLabel="About NAV" />
    </TooltipTrigger>
    <TooltipContent>The price of one unit of the fund, updated every working day.</TooltipContent>
  </Tooltip>
</HStack>

from.quote: One sentence that says what NAV means, opened from the i next to it.

examples.purpose: Custom width: a set width of 200 px, Figma's Custom Width On, so the longer XIRR explanation wraps sooner. Without width the bubble hugs its text up to 280 px.

      <IconButton iconName="ic_info" accessibilityLabel="About XIRR" />
    </TooltipTrigger>

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called on every open and close, also when the Tooltip is uncontrolled. Declared: Callback when visibility changes.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Default false, from the component source.

props.name: placement
props.description: A bubble that doesn't fit flips to the opposite side; left or right with no room either way fall back to top or bottom, whichever has more space; every bubble is clamped 8 px inside the screen. Declared: Preferred placement of the tooltip. Default "top", from the component source.

props.name: TooltipTrigger.asChild
props.description: On TooltipTrigger: with asChild the child itself becomes the trigger (the guide passes an info IconButton). Without it the trigger is a Pressable wrapping the child, and the child gets pointerEvents none, so a press on a nested Coin Button or IconButton reaches the trigger and opens it too.

props.name: TooltipContent.width
props.description: On TooltipContent: a set bubble width in px, Figma's Custom Width On. Omit it and the bubble hugs its text up to 280 px.

modes.name: Color Mode
modes.description: The only collection Tooltip reads. Padding, type, arrow, radius and max width don't change with any mode. Declared: A token collection Tooltip reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

gaps.text: Figma draws only a downward arrow near the bubble's bottom left or right, in two variants (Custom Width Off and On); in code the arrow points at the trigger's centre and the bubble takes 12 placements.
The code adds a fixed drop shadow and the full-window layer that closes it; Figma shows neither.
From the code, not tested: Tooltip imports react-dom's portal at the top of the file, and react-dom is only a devDependency of the package.
